jurisdiction.license: Ondo Global Markets SPV; Regulation S restrictions

genius.notes: USDon is issued by a BVI-incorporated SPV (Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited) under Regulation S, explicitly restricted to non-U.S. investors. It functions as the internal settlement stablecoin for Ondo Global Markets tokenized-stock platform. The GENIUS Act addresses foreign payment stablecoin issuers (FPSIs) accessing U.S. markets separately from domestic PPSIs; because USDon is structurally excluded from U.S.-person access, the payment-stablecoin classification and any FPSI pathway remain genuinely unresolved pending final FPSI rulemaking.

mintAuthority.summary: USDon (ETH) is an ERC1967 proxy (impl=USDon contract with AccessControlEnumerable); ProxyAdmin (0x5244…) is owned by a TimelockController (2h delay, 0x3715…); MINTER_ROLE held by GMTokenManager (0x2c15…) and a 3-of-6 Safe (0x7607…); DEFAULT_ADMIN = Timelock. BSC is structurally equivalent.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 (2026-06-11), getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE) on USDon proxy (0xace8e719899f6e91831b18ae746c9a965c2119f1) returned 2. getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c (GMTokenManager, a 12828-byte contract). GMTokenManager's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE[0] = 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1 (same TimelockController as ProxyAdmin owner).

controls.label: Ondo Safe 3-of-6 (Ethereum MINTER_ROLE[1])
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 (2026-06-11), getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x7607c08928bdbab77f88872b49667dcb877524db. getOwners() returned 6 owners; threshold()=3; getModulesPaginated returned 0 modules.

controls.label: TimelockController ProxyAdmin owner (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 (2026-06-11), EIP-1967 proxy admin slot of USDon returned 0x5244a3d8e6534d253c11b9459a4c4c6d3b2361dd (ProxyAdmin contract). ProxyAdmin.owner()=0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1 (TimelockController). Timelock minDelay=7200s (2h), PROPOSER_ROLE count=1 (PROPOSER[0]=0x71a4d411b5f7941dee020417fca30413712f1646 is a 4-of-7 Safe), EXECUTOR_ROLE count=2 (EXECUTOR[0]=0x2e55b738f5969eea10fb67e326bee5e2fa15a2cc is 1-of-8 Safe; EXECUTOR[1]=0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b is EOA). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on USDon token = same Timelock.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 and BSC block 103630432 (2026-06-11): USDon ETH proxy (0xace8…) has EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin=0x5244… owned by TimelockController 0x3715… (2h delay). Token MINTER_ROLE has 2 holders: GMTokenManager (0x2c15…) and 3-of-6 Ondo Safe (0x7607…, no modules). DEFAULT_ADMIN = Timelock; Timelock PROPOSER = 4-of-7 Safe, EXECUTOR = 1-of-8 Safe + EOA. BSC structurally equivalent: MINTER_ROLE[0]=GMTokenManager(0x91f8…), MINTER_ROLE[1]=contract, DEFAULT_ADMIN=0x8860… (contract). Impl (USDon) confirmed on Blockscout. Regulation S restricts U.S.-person minting; no permissionless mint path. USDon is issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited; Ondo's Trust & Transparency page scopes its only third-party feed (Ankura Trust) to tokenized-stock holdings, not USDon's brokerage cash, and no dated independent report of USDon's specific cash reserve was found, so reconciliation is unknown. Ondo's own disclaimer states the issuer and tokens are not registered or licensed by the BVI FSC, SEC, CFTC or any financial regulator, so supervision is none.

reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-07-20 against issuer documentation fetched today: the available-assets page states 'USDon is a stablecoin backed 1:1 by a US dollar in one of Global Markets' brokerage accounts', and the investing-and-redeeming page states each USDon is backed by 'a dollar of cash or equivalents at a Global Markets brokerage account' with redemptions to USDon documented as always instant; the slice is renamed to the issuer's cash-or-equivalents language and liquidityHorizon set to immediate accordingly. The trust-and-transparency page scopes Ankura Trust's daily verification to tokenized-stock securities and their collateral; no USDon-specific cash balance, brokerage identity, account reconciliation, or reserve assurance was found, so the 100% insufficient-evidence disposition is retained. The July 2025 Cyfrin Global Markets audit and the fixed-block token-source review carried from the 2026-07-15 review remain the contract-side evidence.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo documents that all Global Markets holdings sit with one or more US-registered custodial broker-dealers and that the issuer is a dedicated BVI SPV with an independent director and full segregation of assets, books, and accounts from Ondo Finance Inc. and the Ondo Foundation group; that supports a structured bankruptcy-remoteness posture at the entity level. Not known: the identity of the broker-dealer(s) holding USDon settlement cash, account titles, whether USDon cash sits in segregated or omnibus accounts, any SIPC or private insurance coverage, and rehypothecation terms. Ankura Trust's first-priority perfected security interest and daily verification are documented for tokenized-stock collateral, and whether either extends to USDon's brokerage cash is unstated. No USDon-specific attestation or report exists, and Ondo's disclaimer states the issuer and tokens are not registered or licensed by the BVI FSC, SEC, CFTC, or any financial regulator.
